description: This file defines the ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable class, which manages implicit subscription entries and subscribers for broadcast channels within an Orleans application. It handles cache management of subscriber predicates, creation of unique subscription identifiers, and resolution of subscriber references based on grain properties and channel IDs.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable
classes.description: Main class managing implicit subscriber table with cache management, subscriber resolution, and cache rebuilding based on channel bindings and predicates.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelSubscriberPredicate
classes.description: Associates a subscriber with a predicate used for namespace matching.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelSubscriber
classes.description: Represents an implicit broadcast channel subscriber, uniquely identified by GrainType and capable of generating GrainIds for channel subscriptions.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Holds cached representations of subscriber predicates and namespace mappings for efficiency.

methods.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the subscriber table with bindings, providers, and service provider.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache, rebuilding if bindings have changed.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Constructs a new cache of predicates and namespace mappings based on current bindings.

methods.name: GetImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Returns all implicit subscribers for a given channel namespace.

methods.name: FindImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Filters and finds all subscribers matching a specific channel namespace.

methods.name: MakeConsumerReference
methods.description: Creates a grain reference for a broadcast channel consumer extension based on grain factory, channel ID, and subscriber info.

methods.name: MakeSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Creates a unique Guid subscription ID based on grain type and channel ID.
